title: From Scratch Brownies
ingredients: Optional : 1/2 cup chopped walnuts or 3 Tbsp instant coffee
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F and grease a 9x9 inch baking pan.
In a mixing bowl, mix the oil, sugar, and vanilla extract.
beat the eggs into the mixture.
Combine the flour cocoa powder, baking powder, and salt.
Gradually stir into the egg mixture until well blended.
Stir in the optional ingredients if needed.
Spread the batter evenly into the greased baking pan.
Bake for 20-25 minutes or until the brownies begin to pull away from the pan.
Let the pan cool on a wire rack before cutting into squares.
